trickyParts: A caller of a reusable workflow must grant every scope the called file's permissions blocks declare, so both worker-image.yaml calls carry contents read, packages/id-token/attestations write; only the jobs inside differ.

The attest condition is a with: input (skip_attest) because check-image-trigger-paths.sh refuses a needs.<X>.outputs or github.ref term in a caller's if:; worker-image.yaml's build job skips on inputs.attest_digest, which check-image-trigger-paths.sh now admits as a call mode.
Without the per-package detach a first attempt still lands both bumps; it is the re-run that breaks (release-push.test.sh shows it), so the detach stays on every package.
check-release-credentials.sh rules were renumbered (old 5 -> 4, old 6 -> 5) when rule 4 went.
deviations: Spec departures recorded in the plan (acceptance 1's reason is tags alone; outcome is 3 stages, replace-pending kept).
worker-image.yaml inputs are named skip_attest and attest_digest (negative names, so pull_request/workflow_dispatch runs where inputs are null behave as before).
The legion_version workflow_dispatch input is removed too: nothing documented it and the version tag moved to release.yaml's worker_image_release.
actionlint 1.7.12 reports only GitHub's newer cache-mode job key (and queue: max in the untouched listener workflow); those findings are ignored with -ignore.
openQuestions: Acceptance 1 and 4 and the 'after' merge-to-published numbers are read after the merge by the production check (measurement script posted on the PR: https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2358#issuecomment-6434025628).
